universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text unless specifically asked.
DO NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Rajdhani'.
DO NOT center-align everything. Use asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
All interactive elements must have a hover state.
Dark mode is the ONLY mode. Do not implement light mode.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building Project Chimera. Start by setting up the global font (Rajdhani) and the dark theme variables in index.css. Create a layout that feels like a spaceship HUD. The main view is an 'Infinite Canvas' where projects float like solar systems. Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds. Focus on 'Calm UX' - hide complex controls until the user hovers or clicks. Use amber/gold for all active states and primary actions.
